proposed.text: A review panel asks why a lobby with the same floor area feels more monumental after its ceiling height is increased. What is the strongest source-backed explanation?

options.text: Room height has a strong effect on perceived human scale.
Floor area alone controls human scale.
Only wall color can make the space feel monumental.
Scale is fixed by the building type and cannot change through dimensions.

rationale.correct: TOA 2 states that room height has greater effect on scale than width or length.
rationale.takeaway: Human scale is read through bodily relation to height, openings, surfaces, and interior elements.
rationale.b: Floor area is not the only scale cue.
rationale.c: Color may affect perception but is not the only factor.
rationale.d: Scale remains a comparative perception, not a fixed building-type label.
